guards.name: design_before_code
guards.rule: Product source remains read-only until the user confirms the revised high-fidelity proposal.

guards.name: permission_boundary
guards.rule: Locked users may view course and directory; playback remains unavailable.

guards.name: task_local_only
guards.rule: This turn writes only task-local mockups and output artifacts.

guards.name: separate_authorization
guards.rule: Deployment, backend/API/database, payment, production data, and Open portfolio actions require separate same-turn authorization.
